player_prompt.intro:
Nawe ngumdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Isikhala sakho si '{symbol}'.
Inhloso yikuthi ugcine ukwenzela umgca ongu-3 (ngokwesobunxele, ngokwesinambatane, noma ngokwesokunene).
Uma wenze umgca ongu-3, ulahleka.
Fakaza umzamo wakho usebenzisa ifomethi '[4]' ukubeka isikhala sakho eselini 4.
Njengomdlali {player_id}, nawe '{symbol}' nobani labo '{opponent_symbol}'.
